task_description: GitHub issue #19: move the conversation UI (ChatPanel: input, send button, transcript, baby disabled hint) from the right-hand controls-area to the left-hand stage-area so it renders next to the monster sprite, making the conversation read as happening right at the monster alongside the #11 speech bubble. Preserve the baby disabled-hint UX, i18n (JA/EN), the pending '…' indicator, and the existing responsive layout.

Live Playwright render not feasible: the browser namespace cannot reach host localhost and the deployed CloudFront URL still serves pre-change main; structural correctness confirmed via tsc build + diff review.
